item.title: Building Flux Filters with Codex to Take Control of My RSS Feeds
item.description:
RSS has been part of how I stay informed for years. I like choosing the sources I follow, receiving every new article in one place, and avoiding an algorithm deciding what deserves my attention.

My RSS reader of choice is Miniflux. It is fast, powerful, and gives me the control I want over my feeds. It is not the most aesthetically pleasing application to read from, though, so on iOS I use ReadKit as the interface for working through my articles.

item.title: Why I Still Use RSS to Stay Informed
item.description: In the age of social media algorithms, personalised feeds, and endless scrolling, it might seem odd to rely on an older technology like RSS to stay informed. But for me, RSS remains one of the best ways to stay on top of my interests without the noise and distractions of modern platforms. Here’s why I still use RSS after all these years, how it helps me cut through the clutter, and why I prefer it over social media algorithms.
